title: Sentinel-1 Likely Damaged Areas
description:
The map is the result of a coherent change detection analysis of interferometric Sentinel-1 radar (InSAR) images comparing post-disaster images with pre-disaster reference images from 2022-2026. Coherent change detection analysis is used to show change across the entire domain, which includes vegetation and forested areas. This analysis is constrained to a snapshot of the FIRIS perimeter domain to highlight the damage to built up areas only.

Each date in this collection is a separate Sentinel-1 pass: January 9, 2025 covers the Altadena/Eaton area; January 13, 2025 covers the Palisades area; January 21, 2025 covers likely damaged structures.

The map is meant for landscape-level geospatial overlay and visualization purposes of fire damage in urban/built-up regions. For example, the map is useful for tabulating estimates of the number of likely damaged or destroyed structures. Pixel values of 1 represent a region likely damaged or destroyed; pixel values of 0 represent all other regions.
